latest_final: The man hid inside a coffin to be carried to its ordinary burial destination. He did not know a corpse was already inside, and he intended to get out after the burial. His plan was connected to the deceased person or their burial, but the clues do not reveal exactly what he hoped to accomplish. Once buried, he struck a match, recognized the corpse, and realized his predicament. The match did not cause his death; he was already trapped underground and died because he could not get enough breathable air.
